11.7.1: after Eliashib, Judas then John (Johanan) high priest; John killed his brother Jesus in the temple; Bagoses, general of "another Artaxerxes", punished the Jews seven years. 11.7.2: Jaddua son of John; his brother Manasseh married Nicaso daughter of Sanballat, sent to Samaria by "Darius, the last king". 11.8.2: elders forced Manasseh from the altar; Sanballat promised him a temple on Gerizim
